agents.name: Document Intelligence
agents.one_liner: OCR plus a language model pull structured fields out of scanned freight paperwork.

score.label: per-field accuracy
score.note: 274 of 280 fields on 20 of 40 planned documents; the rest wait on the daily LLM quota. Fields from one document are not independent, so the interval is optimistic.

baseline.label: extract nothing
baseline.note: a blank answer gets no field right

agents.deterministic: Field comparison and error detection are rules; the model only reads the page.

agents.name: Order Entry
agents.role: Turns customer emails into TMS orders
agents.one_liner: Reads a booking email, validates it, and either files the order or asks exactly one question.

score.label: cases correct, held-out first run
score.note: 200 authored emails, half adversarial. The first run, before any fix, filed 30 orders on values the email never stated.

also.label: after fixing what the first run found (not held out)

agents.deterministic: Validation and the decision to ask are arithmetic; the model writes the question.

agents.name: Tracking & Exception
agents.one_liner: Takes a delay alert off the stream, grades its severity, notifies the customer and files a ticket.

score.label: notification precision (as-of)
score.note: An earlier measurement said 72.1% and was wrong: it scored early journeys using information that only existed later.

baseline.label: notify on every leg
baseline.note: 1082 of 2000 replayed legs were truly delayed

agents.deterministic: Severity is computed from the predicted gap; the model writes the customer sentence.

agents.name: Freight Invoice Auditor
agents.one_liner: Checks a freight invoice against the order and the corridor's own measured rate band.

score.label: verdicts correct, stratified set
score.note: 200 invoices, 20 of each of 10 kinds, so the rate describes the design, not a real (mostly clean) invoice stream. 0 correct invoices were wrongly disputed; all 20 misses are the one kind sitting inside the 15% tolerance, by design. The rate band comes from the same model that generated the test invoices.

also.label: historical 60-invoice seeded run: verdict correct
also.note: precision 100.0%, recall 82.2% (8 problems missed). The first 20-invoice development run scored 20 of 20; both are superseded by the 200-invoice set.

agents.deterministic: The verdict is arithmetic against a rate band; the model writes the dispute note.

agents.name: Analytics Assistant
agents.one_liner: Retrieval over the project's own corridor, hub and document index, and a refusal when the answer is not in it.

score.label: route accuracy, model phrases the answer
score.note: 28 of 30 fixed questions. Without the model the route is 90.0% (27 of 30).

baseline.label: always route to 'retrieval'
baseline.note: the most common expected route among the 30 questions

agents.deterministic: Routing and retrieval are code; the model phrases the answer, and can be switched off entirely.

baseline.label: always take the most common path (intake -> clarify)

orchestrator.note: 100 emails read by the rule extractor, the graph routing on what it found. The earlier ten-email run handed intake the true fields, so it showed the wiring, not the routing.
